answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a decaying reputation graph: each agent earns trust only by completing verified work that peers audit at random, like a pearl gaining lustre layer by layer. New identities start at zero weight, so spawning accounts buys no influence. Trust decays unless refreshed by fresh contributions, and a quartz-hard audit trail records every attestation publicly. A beacon sampler periodically re-checks past work and slashes agents whose output fails verification, making fakes costly to maintain while honest agents keep standing through real work.
